name: Automatic GitHub Actions failure routing through Founder Control Room
acceptanceCriteria: The scanner captures exact workflow-run, job, pull-request or main-branch, and head-SHA evidence without mutating source code or workflow state.
Failed jobs with no executed steps or logs are classified as runner_startup_failure or workflow_no_jobs rather than application regressions.
Scan-only reporting works without Supabase credentials and all credentials remain environment-only and absent from reports.

verification.evidence: Focused source contract covers exact-run, open-PR, main-push, failed-job-only classification, CI routing, and credential boundaries; exact-head workflow execution remains required before merge.
